title: Listings Rate Note — How a Listing's Pet-Fee Ceiling Is Calculated
content:
# Rate Note: The Pet-Fee Ceiling of a Listing

*Pricing team note for Roamhaven Listings.*

## Clause

A listing's pet fee may be no higher than its pet-fee ceiling, and a pet fee standing above that ceiling is reset to the ceiling exactly, the reset being logged as one change of the pet fee; a pet fee at or below the ceiling is left as it stands.

The pet-fee ceiling of a listing is the pet-fee maximum of the listing's space type, in US dollars to the cent, rounded half up to the cent at the final step only.

## What the calculation reads

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| the listing's space type | the listing record |
| the space type's pet-fee maximum | the space type's figure for the pet-fee maximum, per stay |
| the pet fee standing on the listing | the listing record |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Suppose a space type whose pet-fee maximum were $120.00.

- The listing's pet-fee ceiling is $120.00.
- A listing of that space type carrying a pet fee of $150.00 stands above its ceiling; the pet fee is reset to $120.00 exactly and one change of the pet fee, from $150.00 to $120.00, is logged.
- A listing of that space type carrying $120.00 stands at its ceiling, and one carrying $80.00 stands below it; both are left as they stand.
